field_principles.phase_spans: Keep real phase boundaries, completed units, and checkpoint references.

field_principles.rows: Keep every capacity fixture, host observation, and lease lifecycle disposition.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260919 and retain actual UTC and monotonic boundaries.
field_principles.runtime_ownership_ready_score: Set one only after repaired capacity checks and one current acquire-read-release lifecycle pass.

field_principles.schema: Use a versioned plain top-level schema with experiment, milestone, and terminal state.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hash exact input bytes and label historical model-shaped evidence as non-current.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Retain exact scoped commands, environments, exits, durations, and hashed logs.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use only positive, circular_positive, null, blocked, disqualified, or partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Use true because the lease protocol and journal validator define ownership correctness.
